name: CAPTCHA Solver
description: Solves CAPTCHAs Mercury runs into on your tasks: your own models read simple ones, a solving service (2Captcha, CapSolver, Anti-Captcha or CapMonster, your key) handles reCAPTCHA, Turnstile and GeeTest, and anything left comes to you.
author: Cosmic Stack

tools.name: solve
tools.description: Solve a CAPTCHA blocking the owner's task. type 'image' (letters/numbers in a picture: pass image_path), 'recaptcha_v2', 'recaptcha_v3', 'turnstile', 'geetest', 'funcaptcha' (pass site_key and page_url, from captcha__detect), 'hcaptcha' or 'audio'. Tries the owner's own models first (images), then the solving service, then asks the owner. Returns the text or token, how it was solved and the cost; for tokens, an `inject` script to run in the page.

tools.name: detect
tools.description: Find CAPTCHAs in a page's HTML (pass html or html_path, and page_url): which kind, its site key and the exact captcha__solve arguments to use.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Show the solving service's remaining balance and today's solves against the daily limit.

service.label: Which solving service?
service.description: Used for reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, GeeTest and images your models can't read. Bring your own key. You can switch anytime.

optionLabels.anticaptcha: Anti-Captcha: strong on image CAPTCHAs, also FunCaptcha
optionLabels.none: No service: only my own models, then ask me

useOwnModels.label: Try my own models first on image CAPTCHAs?
useOwnModels.description: Your Mercury models (any provider you set up that can see images) read simple text CAPTCHAs for free before the paid service is used.

optionLabels.true: Yes: free when they can read it
optionLabels.false: No: go straight to the service

askMe.label: Ask me when nothing else works?
askMe.description: Sends the CAPTCHA to your phone, chats and Mercury Desktop and waits for your answer. Bots never ask.

askTimeoutMinutes.label: How long to wait for me (minutes)
askTimeoutMinutes.description: 1 to 4: one solve can take at most 5 minutes in all. For longer, Mercury asks you itself with ask_owner.

dailyLimit.label: Paid solves per day (most)
dailyLimit.description: Stops using the paid service after this many solves in a day (your time zone). 0 = no paid solves.
